The Government of Pirabad has confirmed that it will be sending a delegation of international observers to monitor the upcoming elections in [nation]Baladullah[/nation]. This step reflects Pirabads longstanding commitment to supporting transparent and credible democratic processes in the region.

Pirabad has repeatedly expressed its desire to strengthen cultural and economic cooperation with Baladullah, emphasizing the shared values and heritage between the two Muslim-majority nations. The participation of our observers is intended to reinforce friendship, mutual understanding, and continued collaboration in trade, education, and regional development.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs reiterates that Pirabad seeks to expand relations based on respect, trust, and long-term partnership.

Mahmoud Nezami
Minister of Foreign Affairs
Pirabad
